source.title: finishing the Dance Central 3 story mode! (Streamed August 20th, 2022)
source.note: Not in the repo: someone else's content. Download with yt-dlp into a fresh directory; every time below is seconds of that file.

layout.player_camera: full frame 1920x1080, front-facing, MIRRORED (a selfie view: shirt text reads backwards at full resolution), whole body visible when dancing; the dancer stays inside x 280..1336. Replays need fixture_transform.py --mirror: unmirrored, every lead scores mean lastfrac 0.49-0.59; mirrored, 0.84
layout.chat_overlay: right side, roughly x 1380..1900, y 520..730, over the camera picture
layout.song_title_card: game inset bottom-left, about 2 s after song time 0
layout.results_card: game inset right: gems = num_perfect, green = num_awesome, score, difficulty, moves_passed percent (perform_endgame.dta); counted only from start_score_move_index on (perform.dta)

alignment: t0 = video time of song time 0, from audio cross-correlation of the song's <id>_prev.webm (scripts/video_calib/song_id_audio.py) and confirmed by the on-screen title card at t0+2 s. The preview chorus repeats inside most songs, so the highest-NCC peak is not always the preview's own position; the title card picks the right one. The title card fixes the song, not a whole-measure offset: getlow's audio peak (4279.7) was 4.66 s (2 measures) early, found by the pose geometry (pose_vs_reference.py over +-15 s: limb error 38.8 deg at 0, 25.6 deg at +4661 ms; every other song has its minimum within +-200 ms and a 6-12 deg margin over any far offset).

songs.note: second attempt; the first (from ~770) was paused and quit

songs.t0_source: pose geometry (audio peak was 2 measures early)

songs.exclude: paused mid-song: gameplay runs ~90 s past the audio-implied end, so song time drifts after the pause; no results card

not_used.what: story finale in the throne room: short dance-craze segments with their own result cards (7776 958,159; 7856 The Hustle 992,846; 7968 668,787; 8208 995,169), remixed audio; preview NCC only 0.2-0.3. Title cards: Macarena 7691, The Hustle 7789, Cupid Shuffle 7869, Scream 7989, Electric Boogie 8101, OMG 8213. See id_sheets.
